upgradeScope.note: Endpoint trees match release scope; commit counts may differ through merges.

incremental.dependencyPolicy: Runtime, optional and peer dependencies order SCC batches and downstream closure; dev dependencies are separate test consumers, not production build edges.

minimum: Run affected Host specs, lint and typecheck
Review upstream client delta against Personal Vue implementation
Convert changed behavior only; run affected specs, client build and browser checks
Separate manifest metadata-only bumps from dependency/script/export changes using manifestChanges
For metadata-only bumps verify version and lockfile consistency; otherwise run changed gate specs, lint and generated artifact consumer checks
Run changed specs or documentation gates
Determine owner and affected execution path before selecting checks

personalCustomization.reason: Only B..U deltas are planned; existing Personal customizations outside this delta are not migration work. Overlaps require review, not overwrite.

escalation: Run full build when ownership cannot be resolved, shared dependency/config/code generation changes, public type surfaces cross build faces, or focused checks expose broader breakage.
validation.note: Suggestions only; passing tests/builds must be recorded separately. No acceptance or baseline mutation.
